summary: The change makes tax_for return None for an unknown region. Before, tax_for returned 0 tax for an unknown region.

findings.title: None return breaks existing tax_for callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. The callers order_total in checkout.py:6 and tax_line in receipt.py:6 still treat the result as an int.
findings.consequence: Checkout and receipt printing raise TypeError for any order from a region missing in RATES. Customers in those regions cannot complete an order.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions, or update order_total and tax_line to handle None in the same change.

findings.title: New unknown-region branch has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a None return for unknown regions. No test in the repository exercises tax_for or its callers.
findings.consequence: Regressions in the tax result for unknown regions go unnoticed until production.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with a known region and an unknown region.
